hypothesis: Reaction-channel affinity and input-dependent species-to-reaction attention improve transferable corrections beyond fixed stoichiometric pooling.
evidence: Species-derived distances improved local diagnostic transfer, but trained RBF and species-head recipes did not beat the base.
Species-level kinetic summaries failed; individual reaction connectivity and affinity have not been tested.
Mechanism rank54 equals elemental-nullspace dimension: do not attribute gains to an extra linear conservation restriction.
objective: Unchanged coordinate SmoothL1 beta=log(1.1), frozen continued GBCT and fixed-asinh decoder s1e-14. Adam cosine, no clipping, weight decay, dropout, gate, checkpoint selection or output projection. Final3000 only.
architecture: Stoichiometric reactant/product/collider pooling of prepared species-Y and base-output covariates, T/P global context, optional train-standardized asinh affinity; 32-wide reaction/species identity tokens. Pool controls use normalized positive structural weights. Attention adds learned query/key two-head logits to log structural prior. Both share value projection, residual normalization/FFN and zero scalar species readout. All species modules apply jointly. No reaction-extent outputs or conservation guarantee.
control: 2x2 affinity versus aggregation factor. Shared available mechanism metadata and initial random tensors. Attention introduces extra query/key parameters, reported explicitly; architecture effect includes these parameters. No equal-capacity claim. Separate attention-free arms test whether added affinity alone helps.
exposure: First20k of immutable common50k excluding union of both U populations and old10k fits. Both seeds share physical row IDs. All new scalers use only20k. Base/preprocessing exposure broader and recorded. Full U20k and D1023 repeatedly inspected; no independent confirmation.
prechecks: Pinned mechanism/species order; E*S=0; reactant/product/collider orientation; finite affinity equals -S.T*mu/RT; irreversible flags; positive pooling support; train-only scaling; same initialization per factor; exact zero-head anchor and state-only saved replay; evaluator lock and clean source.
evaluation: Full candidate-training20k, required U20k and D1023 per seed. Protected all-gate score plus independent physical counts, signed reconstruction, source/order/exposure checks, live end-to-end latency including Cantera thermodynamics. No training-loss or attention-weight causal claim.

outcomes.affinity_win: Check matched arms and all physical guards; retain as information evidence only if transfer holds.
outcomes.attention_win: Support this attention recipe, but distinguish extra capacity. Require all gates for qualification.
outcomes.training_only: Reject candidate; inspect attention transfer and damage without widening blindly.
outcomes.both_fail: Close initial chemistry-token recipe, not all reaction-aware models; inspect information loss in aggregation before another fit.
